annotations.title: Get a garment tech pack template

description: Use this tool when someone needs to prepare a tech pack (technical sheet / ficha técnica) for a factory: give the garment family (sweatshirt, knitwear, denim, bags, tshirt, dress) and get the sections a factory needs, the points of measure with how to measure each one and usual tolerances, materials/BOM and trims, construction, EU labelling rules, quality checks, typical lead time, and which fields also feed the EU Digital Product Passport. From Cycle Studio; free and deterministic, no account needed.

family.description: Garment family or a garment name: sweatshirt, hoodie, knitwear, sweater, denim, jeans, bag, tote, t-shirt, dress, blouse…

sample_size.description: Size the sample is made in, default M.

name: get_techpack_template
